summaries.en: MTProxy is a lightweight proxy server designed to bypass internet censorship by securely relaying Telegram traffic through intermediary servers. Its technical innovation lies in using the MTProto protocol with built-in obfuscation techniques that disguise proxy traffic as ordinary HTTPS, making it harder for firewalls to detect and block. Developers can deploy it on cloud servers to create personal access points, modify its C codebase for custom routing rules, or integrate it into network monitoring tools to study traffic obfuscation methods in practice.

summaries.en: SLIME is an open-source framework designed to scale reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) during post-training, addressing the challenge of efficiently aligning LLMs with complex objectives beyond basic instruction following. Its technical innovation lies in optimizing RL scaling strategies specifically for LLMs, enabling more stable and effective training through tailored reward modeling and policy optimization techniques. Researchers and developers can use SLIME to fine-tune pre-trained LLMs for specialized tasks like creative writing or code generation, experimenting with custom reward functions to shape model behavior toward specific goals.
summaries.zh: SLIME 是一个专为大型语言模型（LLM）设计的强化学习（RL）后训练框架，旨在解决LLM在复杂目标对齐中的扩展难题。它通过优化RL在LLM中的应用策略，例如定制奖励模型和策略优化方法，提升训练稳定性和效果，让模型能更好地适应多样化任务。开发者可利用该框架对预训练模型进行微调，应用于创意写作或代码生成等场景，通过自定义奖励函数引导模型行为，实现更精准的目标对齐。

summaries.en: DebugSwift is an open-source iOS debugging toolkit that simplifies identifying and resolving common app issues like crashes and memory leaks. It provides real-time visual overlays for layout inspection and automated leak detection, making debugging more intuitive than traditional console logs. Developers can integrate it via CocoaPods to monitor app performance during development, enabling faster iteration and more robust iOS applications.
summaries.zh: DebugSwift 是一款开源 iOS 调试工具包，旨在简化应用崩溃、内存泄漏等常见问题的定位与解决。它通过实时视觉覆盖层进行布局检查，并自动检测内存泄漏，使调试过程比传统控制台日志更直观。开发者可通过 CocoaPods 集成，在开发阶段监控应用性能，从而加速迭代并构建更稳定的 iOS 应用。该工具特别适合需要快速调试界面布局或优化内存管理的场景，让开发工作更高效。

summaries.en: AIOS-Core is a JavaScript framework that simplifies building AI-powered full-stack applications by orchestrating multiple AI agents. Its key innovation is treating AI agents as modular components that can be chained together through a clean API, enabling complex workflows without deep AI expertise. Developers can use it to create automated systems like content generators or customer service bots by defining agent roles and interactions in TypeScript/Node.js, making advanced AI accessible for practical web development projects.
summaries.zh: AIOS-Core是一个JavaScript框架，专门用于简化AI驱动的全栈应用开发，通过协调多个AI智能体来实现复杂任务。其核心设计理念是将AI智能体视为可组合的模块化组件，开发者可以通过清晰的API将它们连接起来，构建自动化工作流而无需深入研究底层AI技术。该框架采用TypeScript/Node.js开发，适合创建内容生成系统、智能客服机器人等实际应用，让开发者能够快速实验多智能体协作模式，将前沿AI能力融入日常开发实践。

summaries.en: Superhuman is a research paper exploring how AI agents can achieve superhuman performance in complex environments like NetHack. It demonstrates that combining large language models with reinforcement learning enables agents to develop sophisticated planning and exploration strategies. Researchers can use this framework to study emergent behaviors in AI systems, applying similar approaches to robotics or scientific discovery tasks where autonomous decision-making is crucial.
summaries.zh: Superhuman是一篇研究论文，探讨AI智能体如何在NetHack等复杂环境中实现超人类表现。该研究通过将大语言模型与强化学习相结合，展示了智能体如何发展出复杂的规划与探索策略。这种方法的核心在于利用语言模型的推理能力指导强化学习的探索过程，使智能体能够理解环境语义并制定长期策略。研究人员可借鉴此框架研究AI系统的涌现行为，将其应用于机器人控制或科学发现等需要自主决策的领域，探索智能体在开放环境中的能力边界。

summaries.en: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct is a lightweight 2-billion-parameter vision-language model that enables conversational AI to understand and reason about both images and text simultaneously. Its technical innovation lies in efficient multimodal fusion architecture that maintains strong reasoning capabilities while being small enough for edge deployment. Developers can use it through Hugging Face Transformers for applications like visual question answering, image captioning, or building interactive AI assistants that process visual content alongside text inputs.
summaries.zh: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 是一个轻量级的 20 亿参数视觉语言模型，能够同时理解图像和文本，实现多模态对话与推理。其技术核心在于高效的跨模态融合架构，在保持较强推理能力的同时，模型尺寸足够小，适合在资源受限的边缘设备上部署。开发者可通过 Hugging Face Transformers 直接调用该模型，应用于视觉问答、图像描述生成，或构建能够结合视觉内容与文本输入的交互式 AI 助手，为实际场景提供灵活的多模态解决方案。
